//: Story Phase 12 crew dialogue: the morning of the trial, the flutter, the dice, three months, one day, regular Garrick, breakfast.
pete.p12_breakfast_1: pete[happy]: Eggs, Captain. EGGS. I'd forgotten eggs were a thing that happened to people.
pete.p12_breakfast_2: pete[annoyed]: He asked me to pull his finger. Two hours in. TWO HOURS.
pete.p12_suspension_1: pete[happy]: Morning, Garrick. Lovely morning, Garrick. Pass the salt, Garrick. I'm going to say Garrick all day.
pete.p12_one_day_1: pete[sad]: Beans. Jumping beans. In the DICE. Of course there were. Of course.
pete.p12_three_months_1: pete[happy]: Three months, Captain. I'm going to sleep in my bed sash until it rots.
pete.p12_before_dice_1: pete[annoyed]: Or at the Stenchmaster's REQUEST. I read that page FOUR times last night and I didn't see it, because it was at the BOTTOM.
pete.p12_before_dice_2: pete[tired]: It didn't count. Bob's die. I said it didn't count. I'll always know I said it.
pete.p12_flutter_1: pete[happy]: I GASPED, Captain. Did you hear me gasp? It was the best gasp of my life.
pete.p12_morning_1: pete: (quietly) I'll count, Captain. Loud and steady. One number a second. I've been practising on the lamp.
pete.p12_morning_2: pete[worried]: You don't have to do this, Captain. I mean, you DO. But you don't HAVE to.
bob.p12_breakfast_1: bob[happy]: I cried at the bacon, Captain. Just a bit. It was so NORMAL.
bob.p12_breakfast_2: bob: He offered me a hat. To pull his finger. I nearly did. For the hat.
bob.p12_suspension_1: bob: He's just Garrick now. Regular Garrick. He looks smaller without the crown. Is that rude?
bob.p12_one_day_1: bob[sad]: The die went for my knees, Captain. It KNEW.
bob.p12_three_months_1: bob[happy]: I'm doing The Three Months! It's a dance! It goes like THIS!
bob.p12_before_dice_1: bob[sad]: It was my lucky die. It rolled a six. Isn't that lucky? Why is everyone cross?
bob.p12_flutter_1: bob[happy]: OH, THE SHAME! I said it, Captain! Just like we practised! He looked SO sad!
bob.p12_morning_1: bob[concerned]: Is it going to be a big one, Captain?
bob[concerned]: Can I stand behind Pete?
gristle.p12_breakfast_1: gristle: Good breakfast. I'll say it once. Then I'll go and check the rigging and not say it again.
gristle.p12_suspension_1: gristle: Without the hat and the crown and the cape, he's just a man in a burgundy suit. Hard to be scared of a man in a burgundy suit.
gristle.p12_one_day_1: gristle: A day's a day, Captain. I've had worse days. Mostly this month.
gristle.p12_three_months_1: gristle[happy]: Three months. I'm going to re-rig the whole ship. Properly. Without anything going off under me.
gristle.p12_before_dice_1: gristle[annoyed]: 'Lost to angry captains.' It names you, Captain. The leaflet names you. Specifically.
gristle.p12_flutter_1: gristle: Disgraceful, I said. I've been waiting forty years to say disgraceful at something that deserved it.
gristle.p12_morning_1: gristle: That knot on your rope, Captain. If I pull it, you come out. If you pull it, nothing happens. Don't pull it.
jim.p12_breakfast_1: jim[happy]: Did you see them eat it, Captain? Did you SEE? Nobody's eaten like that since Portsmouth.
jim.p12_breakfast_2: jim[angry]: He came at me with the finger. In MY galley. I showed him the ladle.
jim.p12_suspension_1: jim[happy]: One day of normal cooking, Captain. I'm going to do it properly. I'm going to make it COUNT.
jim.p12_one_day_1: jim[angry]: Jumping beans. Beans in the dice. Beans have been ruining my life for a MONTH and now they've ruined the dice too.
jim.p12_three_months_1: jim[happy]: Bread. Real bread. Every day. For three MONTHS.
jim.p12_before_dice_1: jim[angry]: He threw my CRYING BEANS over his SHOULDER. In handfuls. Looking for a DIE.
jim.p12_flutter_1: jim[happy]: It FLUTTERED, Captain! I SAW it! Twenty-one days! I'm going to cook vegetables!
jim.p12_morning_1: jim: No beans in his breakfast this morning, Captain. Not one. He'll go off on last night's alone.
jim.p12_morning_2: jim[annoyed]: My good cloth. On your face. I don't want it back. Don't ever give it back.
ned.p12_breakfast_1: ned: There was an orange, Captain. A whole orange. I haven't seen an orange since I don't know when.
ned.p12_suspension_1: ned: About twenty hours to go, Captain. I'm keeping count. On the wall. With the crayon.
ned.p12_one_day_1: ned: I've crossed it out. I've written ONE DAY. Smaller.
ned.p12_three_months_1: ned: I wrote THREE MONTHS in the log. In big letters.
ned: I'm going to have to cross it out, aren't I.
ned.p12_before_dice_1: ned: Six dice. It sent SIX. So none of them could go missing. It's a shark in a storm and it thinks ahead.
ned.p12_flutter_1: ned: I was a WITNESS, Captain. I've never been a witness before. I want it in the log.
ned.p12_morning_1: ned: I'll be at the rail, Captain. I won't be any closer. I'll point from the rail. I'm a very good long-distance pointer.
rusty_tom.p12_breakfast_1: rusty_tom: (from the bow, very far away) IS HE STILL DOING THE FINGER?
rusty_tom.p12_suspension_1: rusty_tom: Don't let him near me with the finger, Captain. I know what that finger means.
rusty_tom.p12_one_day_1: rusty_tom[sad]: One day. Tomorrow somebody's going to have to hold it again. Not me. Please not me.
rusty_tom.p12_three_months_1: rusty_tom[happy]: Three months nobody holds anything!
rusty_tom.p12_before_dice_1: rusty_tom: Court-appointed sash holders. Emergency appointees. I'm keeping well away from the Court, Captain.
rusty_tom.p12_flutter_1: rusty_tom[happy]: YOU held it, Captain. Not me. Not me. Not me. I'm so happy it wasn't me.
rusty_tom.p12_morning_1: rusty_tom[alarmed]: I've got a cold, Captain. A very catching cold. It's catching right now.
barnacle_bill.p12_breakfast_1: barnacle_bill: Good tea. Tasted of tea. Haven't said that in a month.
barnacle_bill.p12_suspension_1: barnacle_bill: He tried me with the finger. I pretended to be asleep. Standing up. It worked.
barnacle_bill.p12_before_dice_1: barnacle_bill: Chairs as proxies. Good. Let a chair do it. Chairs don't have noses.
barnacle_bill.p12_flutter_1: barnacle_bill: Saw it flutter. From behind the mast. Good mast.
barnacle_bill.p12_morning_1: barnacle_bill: Same cold as Tom. Very catching. Not related to Tom either.
hale.p12_breakfast: hale: Somebody brought me up a plate of eggs, Captain. EGGS. I nearly cried at the wheel.
hale.p12_suspension: hale: Plain Garrick came up for air. Stood by the rail a while. Didn't say a word. Strange to see.
hale.p12_one_day: hale: I heard the cheering stop. I won't ask.
hale.p12_three_months: hale: I heard the cheering from up here. Three months, they're saying. I'll believe it when I see it.
hale.p12_before_dice: hale: A second flying machine. With a winch. I've started waving. It's only polite.
hale.p12_flutter: hale: I saw it from the helm. The sash. Sideways, like a flag. I've never seen anything so beautiful.
hale.p12_morning: hale: The sky's the same as yesterday, Captain. Grey, green and full of sharks. Good luck down there. Or up here. Wherever it happens.
nell.p12: nell: We heard it from the hold, Captain. The cheering. Then the not cheering.
sully.p12: sully: There was an orange at breakfast. Jim cut it in eleven. It was the best eleventh of an orange I've ever had.
fennimore.p12: fennimore: Somebody took the bottle goggles out of the salvage crate. I was saving those.
wick.p12: wick: He came down here with his finger out. We all pretended to be cargo.
rook.p12: rook: One day. Then what? Don't answer that.
brask.p12: brask: A new token came down the hold hatch: NOISE COMPLAINT. Fair.
jory.p12: jory: Was it really thirty seconds, Captain? Behind him? I'd have lasted three.
finch.p12: finch: The die's still there, on the galley floor. Three. Nobody'll touch it.
mags.p12: mags: I'm knitting you a medal, Captain. For the thirty seconds. It's going to be green.
quill.p12: quill: I've written 'flutter' in the log so many times it's stopped looking like a word.
penhallow.p12: penhallow: The treasure-room door's still got Gristle's sign. Nobody's been near it. Good.
garrick.p12_breakfast_1: garrick: It tasted of FOOD, Captain. Just food. Like a normal person's breakfast. I've never felt so ordinary.
garrick.p12_breakfast_2: garrick[gastro]: Twenty hours. Twenty HOURS. Captain, as a FRIEND... pull my finger.
garrick.p12_suspension_2: garrick[worried]: (feeling for a crown that isn't there) It's very draughty, being regular.
garrick.p12_one_day_1: garrick[relieved]: One day! The beans saved me, Captain. Beans have always looked after me.
garrick.p12_three_months_1: garrick[alarmed]: (to the die) Why. WHY. I was always good to you. I kept you on a SHELF.
garrick.p12_before_dice_1: garrick[smug]: At the Stenchmaster's request, Captain. It's on page nine. You must have missed it. It's at the bottom.
garrick.p12_flutter_1: garrick[alarmed]: It FLUTTERED. In front of EVERYONE. I'll never live it down. Gustavio never did.
garrick.p12_morning_1: garrick[gastro]: (holding his stomach) It's a SPECIAL one, Captain. You'll be able to tell your grandchildren.
garrick.p12_morning_2: garrick[gastro]: Gloooorp. Excuse me. That was the overture.
squawks.p12_before_dice_1: squawks[smug]: Dice. Sold separately. Not anymore.
